{"code": "from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder
import numpy as np

# Prepare data for regression: adjust for site and severity
# Use one-hot encoding for site and severity
encoder = OneHotEncoder(sparse=False, drop='first')

# Combine site and severity into a single feature matrix
features = data[['site', 'severity']].copy()
encoded_features = encoder.fit_transform(features)

# Create feature names
feature_names = encoder.get_feature_names_out(['site', 'severity'])

# Create full feature matrix with treatment arm
X = np.column_stack([encoded_features, data['arm'] == 'treatment'])

# Target
y = data['responded']

# Fit logistic regression model
model = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)
model.fit(X, y)

# Extract coefficient for treatment
# The last column is treatment (1 if treatment, 0 if control)
treatment_coef = model.coef_[0][-1]

# Convert log-odds to risk difference (using average marginal effect)
# Predict probabilities under treatment and control
X_control = X.copy()
X_control[:, -1] = 0  # Set treatment to 0
X_treatment = X.copy()
X_treatment[:, -1] = 1  # Set treatment to 1

p_control = model.predict_proba(X_control)[:, 1]
p_treatment = model.predict_proba(X_treatment)[:, 1]

# Average treatment effect in terms of risk difference
ate = np.mean(p_treatment - p_control)

# Output
ate"}
